title: knowledge(performance): add trigger-only fields to API pages with AddLoadFields
summary: New knowledge article documents how to use AddLoadFields on API pages to prevent JIT loading failures when accessing unbound fields in OnAfterGetRecord.
key_points: Explains a common API pattern where unbound fields trigger implicit Get calls on first access
Shows how to use Rec.AddLoadFields in OnOpenPage to prevent 'Inconsistent read' and JIT loading errors
Distinguishes between AddLoadFields (correct) and SetLoadFields (incorrect, breaks layout-based loading)
Provides bad and good code examples for the pattern
References evidence from Microsoft Learn and BCApps ExpenseAgent API pages
